elements.text:
A group of your friends are talking about getting allowance from their parents. Your parents can't afford to give you an allowence, and you have to work a job after school to make money. 

Here are some feelings that might happen in the moment:

texts: I feel more independent than I probably would if I just received an allowance.
I feel ashamed of my family's financial situation and want to hide it.
I feel a genuine sense of pride in the money I earn myself.
I feel a sting of envy listening to my friends talk about their allowances, and let myself acknowledge that without acting on it.
I feel left out of the conversation, but remind myself that this moment doesn't reflect my overall place in the friend group.
